notes: New help command at the controller prompt. help lists every console command grouped by purpose; help NAME explains one command, its arguments and its aliases. Unknown and blank input now points at help instead of reprinting a wall of text. The test suite reads the console dispatcher and fails if any command it accepts is undocumented, so the help cannot drift. Documentation reorganised: the README is now an operator guide, the design and crop reference moved to docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, and CLAUDE.md records the module map, conventions and release process.
